items.question: By offering bilva leaves to Shiva, is one freed from great sins without doubt?
premises: bilva leaves are dear to Shiva
offering them casts away great sins
items.inference: therefore offering bilva leaves frees one from great sins

items.plain_english: By offering bilva leaves to Shiva, one is freed from great sins; there is no doubt about this.
